verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single marketing line saying developers can 'work on local projects' via Blink Files. It does not say those files can come from other apps' sandboxes. The drag-and-drop item covers text selections between apps, not files or repositories. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of accessing files or folders in other apps' sandboxes (e.g., via the iOS Files/document provider), working with repositories stored by other apps, any how-to docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
